ops.title: gt submit anchors on local trunk, which lets harness worktree branches poison a stack
ops.body:
## The fact

`ccx vcs ship`'s graphite lane derives every `base`, `baseSha`, and PR-create
title range from the **local** trunk branch, not `origin/<trunk>`. When the local
trunk is behind the remote, a branch whose commits are already upstream still
measures as having real commits, so `gtSubmitPlan` (`internal/cli/shipgt.go:664`)
plans it as a `SubmitCreate` and Graphite refuses the whole submit request with an
HTTP 400.

Observed 2026-09-04 in `Forge-AI/monorepo`: local `dev` 9 commits behind
`origin/dev`; `worktree-wf_80dcbd59-34c-3` (0 commits above `origin/dev`, no PR,
not on origin) was gt's recorded parent of `yasyf/iris-edge-token` and got planned
as a PR create.

## Two compounding causes

1. **Harness worktree branches get adopted into the Graphite stack.**
   `shipPreflightGT`'s `gt track -f` (`internal/cli/shipgt.go:357`) adopts an
   untracked branch onto whatever parent gt picks, and `~/.claude/worktrees`
   branches named `worktree-wf_*` / `worktree-agent-*` are eligible. That repo's
   gt metadata tracks 9 of them, one already pushed to origin
   (`refs/heads/worktree-agent-a89444fc575f8b206`), plus 13 tracked branches whose
   heads are fully contained in `origin/dev`.
2. **`ccx vcs prune` orphans children.** `pruneApply`
   (`internal/cli/prune.go:174`) forgets a gt row without touching its children,
   so pruning an interior parent leaves a child pointing at a branch that no
   longer exists and `gtDownstack` (`internal/cli/shipgt.go:159`) then fails on
   that whole stack.

## Diagnostic trap

Since `d595811` (v0.52.0, 2026-09-01) ship's gt lane no longer shells `gt submit`
— it calls Graphite's HTTP API directly (`internal/gtapi`). **Its requests appear
nowhere in `~/.local/share/graphite/debug/`**, so a failed ship leaves no trace in
gt's own debug corpus. Anything found there during a ship incident is a *human or
agent's own* `gt` invocation, distinguishable by flag order: ccx builds
`--no-interactive` before `--no-edit` and always passes `--no-ai`.

A whole-request non-2xx also fell into `gtSubmitFailure`'s `default:` arm
(`shipgt.go:776`) as a bare wrapped error with no advice and no `--no-commit`
resume line, and `statusError` (`internal/gtapi/errors.go:77`) decoded only
`{"message"}` — so the operator saw "400" and nothing else. That is why an agent
abandoned ship and ran raw `gh pr create`.

## Checking a stack for this

    ccx vcs info                      # names the downstack ccx would actually submit
    sqlite3 .git/.graphite_metadata.db \
      "select branch_name, parent_branch_name from branch_metadata where branch_name like 'worktree-%' or parent_branch_name like 'worktree-%';"
    git rev-list --count origin/<trunk>..<branch>   # 0 means nothing to submit
